question: MS Subbulakshmi, a legend in India is known for which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Carnatic music.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi:-**

 
 
• She​ was a **renowned Carnatic vocalist **and **musician** who popularized the** genre of Carnatic music **not only in India but around the world.
 
• She was the** first musician** to be awarded the **Bharat Ratna, **India's highest civilian award, for her contribution to music.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi's music was deeply rooted in the tradition of **Carnatic music, **which has its origins in South India.
 
• She was known for her renditions of** devotional songs and bhajans **in the Carnatic style, which were widely appreciated by audiences of all backgrounds.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Ghazal music:-**

 
 
• It is a form of **poetic expression** set to music that originated in the **Middle East and South Asia**.
 
• It is characterized by its use of** rhyming couplets** and a **melancholic tone.**
 
 
 
• **Sufi devotional **music:-
 
 
• It is a form of **Islamic devotional music** that is popular in South Asia and the Middle East.
 
• It is characterized by its use of **poetry **and music to express devotion to God.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani music:-**
 
 
• It is a classical music tradition that originated in **North India.**
 
• It is characterized by its** use of ragas,** which are **melodic frameworks **for improvisation.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic music:-**
 
 
• It is a classical music tradition that originated in** South India**.
 
• It is characterized by its use of **ragas and talas,** which are **rhythmic cycles.**
